Step 22: Search for 'Turn Windows features on or off'. Step 23: Enable Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL). Step 24: Restart your computer. Step 25: Install Ubuntu from Microsoft Store. Step 26: Open Ubuntu terminal. Step 27: Run commands from the Linux installation steps above. SECTION 7 – INSTALL REDIS CLIENT LIBRARY FOR PYTHON Step 28: Open Command Prompt or Terminal. Step 29: Run command: pip install redis Step 30: Wait for installation to complete. SECTION 8 – TEST REDIS WITH PYTHON Step 31: Open Python interpreter. Step 32: Import Redis library: import redis Step 33: Connect to Redis server. Step 34: Run a simple test command to verify connection.
